Name: Clint's Basement Dwarf
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
If you're looking for affordable ore, trading options for ores and minerals, or just to spite Clint, you've come to the right place! This mod adds a trapdoor right next to Clint's shop entrance that leads into a small, cave-like basement, where a dwarf has opened up his shop. There, you can purchase and trade for ores and mining equipment, or trade geodes for specific minerals.
You can also directly purchase tool upgrades. You receive the finished tool immediately. The old tool isn't deleted automatically, so if you don't want those to clutter up your stuff, I recommend placing a chest in the shop area to place them in.

The Dwarf is a non-social NPC who tends to his shop 24/7. Without the key to the town, you are limited to the times that you can access the blacksmith building.
Here's what the Dwarf's shop has to offer:

[b]Ores[/b]
1 Copper ore - 50g
1 Copper ore  - 10 stone
2 Copper ore  - 1 iron ore 
4 Copper ore  - 1 gold ore 
6 Copper ore  - 1 Iridium ore

1 Iron ore - 100g
1 Iron ore - 2 copper ore
2 Iron ore - 1 gold ore
4 Iron ore - 1 iridium ore

1 Coal - 100g

1 Gold ore - 200g
1 Gold ore - 4 copper ore
1 Gold ore - 2 iron ore
2 Gold ore - 1 iridium ore

1 Iridium ore - 500g
1 Iridium ore - 2 gold ore


[b]Minerals[/b]
1 mineral - 10 geodes of its type (normal, frozen, magma) 
[b]
Mining equipment[/b]
Cherry Bomb - Topaz
Bomb - Amethyst 
Mega Bomb - Emerald 
Explosive Ammo - Aquamarine 
Spicy Eel - Ruby

[b]Tool upgrades[/b]
You can upgrade your tools directly though this shop. Because the dwarf is way more chill than Clint, you receive your new tool immediately and keep your old one. The prices are the same. 

Enjoy!
